# CiteClear

> A citation verification and source-quality tool that checks whether cited sources are real, relevant, current, and accurately quoted before citations damage credibility. Deterministic browser checks run first; optional AI-assisted review runs only when the user chooses it.

By Das Group LLC. Last updated: 2026-08-18.

## Key facts
- For: legal teams, researchers, academics, analysts, consultants.
- Checks: source existence, broken links, citation formatting (APA/MLA/Chicago/Bluebook/IEEE), stale sources, quote/source mismatch, claim-to-source alignment, credibility scoring.
- Pricing: Free Starter plan; paid from $29/month.
- Privacy: local preflight first, no model training on pasted text, optional AI review only.
